name: Boom Chaka Laka | 1.3g Live Resin Tarantula | Blueberry Pancakes
description: Warm, sweet, and seriously comforting — Blueberry Pancakes stacks rich berry flavor with smooth, relaxing effects made for winding down. This indica leans cozy and calm, delivering a mellow body high that feels like a slow morning with nowhere to be.
